item.title: Apache Camel CXF-RS / CXF / Knative Inbound Header Injection to RCE (CVE-2026-47323)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-47323 (Apache Camel security advisory). Status: Weaponized (complete self-driving lab reproducer: victim CXF-RS route feeding a camel-exec sink, attacker driver that injects the headers, and an on-disk success check; not rebuilt or executed while preparing this entry). Affects: Apache Camel: camel-cxf-rest (CxfRsHeaderFilterStrategy), camel-cxf-transport (CxfHeaderFilterStrategy) and camel-knative-http (KnativeHttpHeaderFilterStrategy). Tags: RCE, header injection, Apache Camel, CXF-RS, CXF, Knative, JAX-RS, camel-exec, Java, unauthenticated, CWE-178, CWE-791.
